tests.name: Native original across several typed links
tests.positive_expected: One Documents original, several exact company-scoped evidence references
tests.negative_control_must_fail: Copy BOL binary into another authoritative file or overwrite prior verification

tests.name: PO-only supplier evidence
tests.positive_expected: Exact native PO identity accepted without a fictitious SO or load; record gap if current schema cannot express it
tests.negative_control_must_fail: Fabricate a plasticos.load for PO-only inbound or match newest transaction

tests.name: Ambiguous reply or alias intake
tests.positive_expected: File remains in Inbox with one review Activity and no auto-compliance
tests.negative_control_must_fail: Recency or partner-only matching chooses wrong order

tests.name: Two companies same reference
tests.positive_expected: File and verification never leak across companies
tests.negative_control_must_fail: Sudo matcher binds another company due to colliding order number

tests.name: Receipt is not verification
tests.positive_expected: A native Request placeholder can be filled, yet business compliance remains pending until authorized verification
tests.negative_control_must_fail: Just uploading a file clears invoice close

tests.name: Partial buyer Receiving
tests.positive_expected: Only quantity and loads explicitly covered become eligible; rest remain pending
tests.negative_control_must_fail: One received PDF confirms all loads or full order

tests.name: CST certificate sufficiency
tests.positive_expected: Certified CST proof inspected; SCALE tag is only a category
tests.negative_control_must_fail: Bare scale tag satisfies certified document requirement

tests.name: Side-effect-free compute
tests.positive_expected: Compliance recompute returns missing IDs without posting or communicating
tests.negative_control_must_fail: Automated file receipt calls account.move.action_post

tests.name: Internal-only Documents Request
tests.positive_expected: Request to authorized internal assignee, external supplier only receives Linda Mail
tests.negative_control_must_fail: Native Request sends upload/share link to supplier

tests.name: Native reminder control collision
tests.positive_expected: No native Documents external reminder if Linda is authoritative; one outbound per party/day/revision
tests.negative_control_must_fail: Documents Activity automatic reminder and Linda both email same supplier

tests.name: Calendar and clock source
tests.positive_expected: Pickup +1/+5 supplier, +2/+6 carrier; delivery +1/+5 buyer, all business-day under approved locale
tests.negative_control_must_fail: Use transaction create_date or pickup for buyer clock

tests.name: Business day and holiday unknown
tests.positive_expected: Known Mon–Fri test passes; holiday behavior remains UNKNOWN until operator policy
tests.negative_control_must_fail: Invent holiday exception or silently send during quiet hours

tests.name: Cancel / supersede while pending
tests.positive_expected: Stops outstanding intent, preserves historical evidence, no new duplicate Activity
tests.negative_control_must_fail: Stale superseded evidence sends reminder after cancellation

tests.name: AI auto-sort cannot approve
tests.positive_expected: Native AI proposes folder/tag, authorized evidence verification remains separate
tests.negative_control_must_fail: AI output sets weights, accepts certificate or posts vendor bill

tests.name: Provider/Studio gate
tests.positive_expected: Manual/native workflow functions with Studio and paid digitization disabled
tests.negative_control_must_fail: Installation triggers AI subscription or external digitization billing

tests.name: Native versions and shortcuts
tests.positive_expected: New version retains historic original; shortcut points to same source
tests.negative_control_must_fail: PDF merge destroys sole original and provenance

tests.name: No blanket accounting lock
tests.positive_expected: Absent CST does not block buyer AR or commercial close; open carrier issue remains
tests.negative_control_must_fail: Missing carrier CST blocks unrelated buyer invoice

tests.name: Two-worker due evaluation
tests.positive_expected: Two cron workers do not create duplicate external intents or Activities; failed SMTP retains unknown
tests.negative_control_must_fail: Race yields two sends or treats queued as sent

tests.name: Use Odoo platform only
tests.positive_expected: Existing Odoo native automation and ir.cron schedule separate domain jobs
tests.negative_control_must_fail: Create separate worker service or global Linda-only scheduler

tests.name: Activation still separate
tests.positive_expected: Installing BRS files changes no Odoo registry, templates, tasks, records, messages or finance
tests.negative_control_must_fail: Install BRS ZIP activates live automation or bank movement

tests.name: 3PL vs dropship proof
tests.positive_expected: Document evidence can associate genuine PO, native picking and load when present without inventing missing entities
tests.negative_control_must_fail: Require SO or PlasticOS load for every PO-only warehouse document

tests.name: Native invoice intake draft
tests.positive_expected: Vendor PDF creates appropriately scoped draft only when accounting owner authorizes
tests.negative_control_must_fail: Native digitization auto-posts or self-bills without vendor invoice

tests.name: Confidential double-blind output
tests.positive_expected: Only recipient-authorized evidence leaves via owner Mail template; no internal folder grant
tests.negative_control_must_fail: Supplier receives buyer Receiving document or access to Documents folder

tests.name: Source law versus implementation
tests.positive_expected: First implementation checks accepted ADRs and installed EE behavior; remains bounded if conflict
tests.negative_control_must_fail: Working BRS suppresses accepted ADR or claims EE test PASS without execution
